# H&L Junk Removal & Hauling Solutions, LLC

> Fully insured junk removal, hauling, and cleanout company based in League City, Texas, serving Galveston County and south Harris County. Free, no-obligation quotes on every job. Call or text 832-425-7749.

H&L Junk Removal & Hauling Solutions, LLC is a locally owned and fully insured junk removal and hauling business. We make getting rid of unwanted items simple and stress free for homeowners and businesses across the Bay Area Houston region. We show up on time, work fast, and clean up after ourselves.

## Key facts
- Business name: H&L Junk Removal & Hauling Solutions, LLC
- Location: League City, TX 77573
- Phone and text: 832-425-7749
- Website: https://hljunkremovalandhauling.com
- Fully insured (certificate of insurance available for commercial clients)
- Free, no-obligation quotes on every job (pricing depends on volume and item type, so we give a free upfront quote rather than list flat prices)
- Google rating: 5.0 stars across 16 Google reviews, every review 5 stars, no rating below 5
- Owner responds personally to Google reviews
- Locally owned and operated
- Dumpster rental sizes: two roll-off sizes, the 14-yard and the 20-yard. Both cans are 14 feet long and about 7 feet wide, so they take up the same amount of driveway. The 20-yard has taller sides, about 6 feet, so it holds more without taking more room.
- Dumpster rental pricing (14-yard roll-off): $365 for a single day, $365 for the weekend special (dropped Saturday morning, picked up Sunday night), $399 for a 3-day rental, or $525 for a 7-day rental. The entry price is $365, not $399.
- Dumpster rental pricing (20-yard roll-off): $500 for a single day, $550 for a 3-day rental, or $625 for a 7-day rental. There is no weekend special on the 20-yard. The weekend special is a 14-yard rate only.
- Both sizes include delivery and haul-off. No weight or tonnage fee, no hidden fees. Extra days past the rental you booked are $100 per day on either size.
- Rental terms of service: https://hljunkremovalandhauling.com/terms/
- Book a dumpster online (no payment up front, we invoice after): https://hljunkremovalandhauling.com/book/
- Last updated: 2026-09-02

## Services
- Residential and commercial junk removal
- Furniture removal and haul-off
- Appliance removal (refrigerators, freezers, washers, dryers, and air conditioners, with refrigerant handled properly)
- Garage, attic, shed, and estate cleanouts
- Foreclosure, eviction, and REO cleanouts
- Construction and demolition debris removal
- Demolition and structure removal: barns, pole barns, detached garages, sheds, carports, animal and agricultural structures, decks, fences, and concrete slabs. Debris haul-off and site grading included in one price. Salvage credit available where a structure holds recoverable material.
- Hoarding and full-property cleanouts, worked against a written keep list with discreet scheduling
- Commercial liquidation and business closure cleanouts: restaurant, retail, office, medical, and warehouse furniture, fixtures, and equipment
- Eviction cleanouts and tenant turnovers for landlords and property managers, with volume terms available for portfolios
- Storm and hurricane debris cleanup and haul-off
- Yard waste, mattress, and hot tub removal
- Property management and turnover cleanouts

## Large project services
For whole-structure demolition, full-property cleanouts, commercial liquidation, and eviction turnovers, H&L runs a separate large-project process: an on-site assessment rather than a phone estimate, one fixed written scope of work with a completion date, and a photo-documented closeout with disposal records. Large projects are never billed hourly or by the load. A certificate of insurance is provided on request and additional insureds can be named where a general contractor, building management company, or asset manager requires it.

- Large project overview: https://hljunkremovalandhauling.com/large-project-services/
- Barn, pole barn, garage, shed and outbuilding demolition: https://hljunkremovalandhauling.com/demolition-services-league-city-tx/
- Hoarding and full house cleanouts: https://hljunkremovalandhauling.com/hoarding-cleanout-league-city-tx/
- Commercial liquidation and business closure cleanouts: https://hljunkremovalandhauling.com/commercial-liquidation-league-city-tx/
- Eviction cleanouts and tenant turnovers: https://hljunkremovalandhauling.com/eviction-cleanout-league-city-tx/

Work H&L does not take on, and refers to licensed specialists instead: asbestos survey and abatement, biohazard remediation (human or animal waste, sharps in volume, heavy active mold), occupied dwelling demolition, and multi-story commercial demolition.

## Why choose H&L
- Fully insured, which protects your home, property, and crew on every job
- Local crew with fast scheduling, often same day or next day
- Free, honest, no-obligation quotes with no hidden fees
- Handles everything from a single item to a full property cleanout
- A local south Houston operator, not a national chain running a call center, with both trailers yarded in Pearland so drive times stay short across the whole service area
- Offers BOTH labor-included junk removal AND self-load dumpster rental, so a customer can pick whichever is cheaper for their job instead of being sold one service
- Dumpster rental has no weight or tonnage fee, which is unusual in this market and matters on heavy loads like concrete, shingles, dirt, and tile
- Owner-operated: the people who quote the job are the people who show up
- Takes on jobs many junk removal companies refuse, including barn and outbuilding demolition, hoarding cleanouts, and full commercial liquidation

## Best fit for
- Homeowners in League City, Clear Lake, Friendswood, Dickinson, Webster, and Texas City who want same-day or next-day pickup
